documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a healthy Q2 FY27 performance with revenue from operations reaching INR682 crores, representing a 16% year-on-year growth driven by new product launches and strong non-GPL demand. The company reiterated its full year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% alongside an EBITDA margin expectation of 35% to 36%. Management highlighted that the Solapur facility Phase 1 is on track to become operational in Q3 FY27, while the Taloja R&D center construction is progressing well. Furthermore, the company remains net debt-free with strong cash and cash equivalents of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026. Alivus Life Sciences Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹6,820 million for Q2 FY27, representing a 16.0% YoY growth supported by healthy demand across key markets.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated the FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects ongoing capacity expansion and development pipeline to sustain business momentum and deliver consistent growth.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY27.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth was driven by new product launches and healthy demand across the existing portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM and ROW markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM and ROW markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Healthy demand trends and enhanced visibility provide confidence in sustaining the growth trajectory through the remainder of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, healthy demand trends and enhanced visibility for H2 FY27 provide us with confidence in sustaining our growth trajectory through the remainder of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 16.0% YoY supported by demand across key markets and recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business delivered strong year-on-year growth driven by new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: Geographically, broad-based growth was observed across all markets during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Geographically, we saw broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter, highlighting the strength of the diversified business.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business performance was muted in Q1 due to inventory rationalisation following a strong Q4.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Chronic therapies accounted for 74% of the top line in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, chronic therapies accounted for 74% of top line in Q1 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is progressing well and is hoped to be on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility at Taloja in Navi Mumbai is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur is progressing as planned and will be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has begun and will proceed on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur a capex of approximately INR 540 crores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter stood at INR197 crores with PAT margins at 28.9%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter stood at INR197 crores with PAT margins at 28.9%, up 390 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 680 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin reached 64.4% in Q2 FY27, up 670 bps YoY, due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin reached 28.9% in Q2 FY27, up 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2%, an increase of 510 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have seen an increase due to the war situation.
margins_costs.quote: So there has been an increase in raw material prices. It's not been very steep and we have managed to pass on a part of it to our customers.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Fixed asset turnover ratio stood at 2.1 times, maintaining above 2x despite ongoing capex.
orders_capacity.quote: FATR is 2.1 times – Asset turns remained above 2x despite the impact of the ongoing capex cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The active DMF and CEP filings globally stood at 617 as on June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing a $82 billion addressable market.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the high-potent API products, 13 have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages, and 9 are in lab development.
orders_capacity.quote: Of these 13 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development and the remaining 9 products are progressing through lab development stages.

orders_capacity.claim: The CDMO business recorded 3.8% year-on-year growth during the first quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our CDMO business recorded 3.8% Y-o-Y growth during the first quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to remain a net debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on Capital Employed (ROICE) expanded to ~34% in H1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated a free cash flow of INR 90 crores during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains mindful of the evolving external environment as they move into the second half of FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we move into the second half of FY27, we remain mindful of the evolving external environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: So while we remain watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment, the strength of our business fundamentals gives us confidence in our growth outlook.

risks_headwinds.claim: The war situation and its impact on raw material prices have made management cautious regarding guidance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices. So we need to be a little bit cautious.
